title: 收集树中金币
summary: 树上部分节点有金币，站在节点可收集距离不超过二的所有金币；可任选起点，沿边移动并最终回到起点，求最少经过边次数。
insight: 先反复删除没有金币的叶子，它们永远不必接近。对剩余最小含币子树，再删除两层叶子，因为站在两层以内的内部节点即可收集这些边缘金币。最终必须遍历剩余核心树的每条边并返回，所以答案是剩余边数的两倍。
pitfalls: 移动路径必须回到起点
无金币分支要递归剥离
第二阶段必须按层冻结队列大小，恰好剥两层

solutions.title: 先剪空叶再剥两层
solutions.idea: 用度数队列得到必须实际遍历的核心树。
steps: 把无金币叶子入队，反复删除并更新邻居度数，继续加入新无金币叶
按队列层次删除恰好两轮叶子
剩余 degree 总和除以二是核心边数

code.java: class Solution { public int collectTheCoins(int[] coins,int[][] edges){int n=coins.length;List<Integer>[] graph=new ArrayList[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();int[] degree=new int[n];for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0]);degree[edge[0]]++;degree[edge[1]]++;}Queue<Integer> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int node=0;node<n;node++)if(degree[node]==1&&coins[node]==0)queue.add(node);while(!queue.isEmpty()){int node=queue.poll();if(degree[node]==0)continue;degree[node]=0;for(int next:graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){degree[next]--;if(degree[next]==1&&coins[next]==0)queue.add(next);}}for(int node=0;node<n;node++)if(degree[node]==1)queue.add(node);for(int round=0;round<2;round++)for(int size=queue.size();size>0;size--){int node=queue.poll();if(degree[node]==0)continue;degree[node]=0;for(int next:graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){degree[next]--;if(degree[next]==1)queue.add(next);}}int degreeSum=0;for(int value:degree)degreeSum+=value;return degreeSum;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun collectTheCoins(coins:IntArray,edges:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=coins.size;val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()};val degree=IntArray(n);for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].add(edge[0]);degree[edge[0]]++;degree[edge[1]]++};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(node in 0 until n)if(degree[node]==1&&coins[node]==0)queue.add(node);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val node=queue.removeFirst();if(degree[node]==0)continue;degree[node]=0;for(next in graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){degree[next]--;if(degree[next]==1&&coins[next]==0)queue.add(next)}};for(node in 0 until n)if(degree[node]==1)queue.add(node);repeat(2){repeat(queue.size){val node=queue.removeFirst();if(degree[node]>0){degree[node]=0;for(next in graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){degree[next]--;if(degree[next]==1)queue.add(next)}}}};return degree.sum()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int collectTheCoins(vector<int>& coins,vector<vector<int>>& edges){int n=coins.size();vector<vector<int>> graph(n);vector<int> degree(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);graph[edge[1]].push_back(edge[0]);++degree[edge[0]];++degree[edge[1]];}queue<int> pending;for(int node=0;node<n;++node)if(degree[node]==1&&!coins[node])pending.push(node);while(!pending.empty()){int node=pending.front();pending.pop();if(!degree[node])continue;degree[node]=0;for(int next:graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){--degree[next];if(degree[next]==1&&!coins[next])pending.push(next);}}for(int node=0;node<n;++node)if(degree[node]==1)pending.push(node);for(int round=0;round<2;++round)for(int size=pending.size();size--;){int node=pending.front();pending.pop();if(!degree[node])continue;degree[node]=0;for(int next:graph[node])if(degree[next]>0){--degree[next];if(degree[next]==1)pending.push(next);}}return accumulate(degree.begin(),degree.end(),0);} };
